mentions.name: Booktunes
mentions.description: This app generates looping music and soundscapes matched to the feel of the chapter of a book the reader is in. Its long-term goal is a video-game-style adaptive music engine that reacts to where you are in a book instead of a game environment, e.g. battle music during fight scenes, calm background music, or matching forest ambience. It is free and requires no sign-in.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on an app to give me the perfect music/soundscape for the books I read.

The current version understands the chapter and generates looping music that matches the feel of the whole chapter.
